entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet tool/new search hardcode NuGet.org instead of honoring configured sources #55792
  • advertising manifest cannot be loaded #55791
  • [AI discovered CI] Linux dotnet.Tests.dll.2 work item times out during command tests #55789
  • FATAL_GC_ERROR in SVR::gc_heap::sort_mark_list (gc.cpp:10804): region_limit == NULL — mark list contains an address outside any region (regions, Server GC, .NET 10.0.11) #55784

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix Linux HTTP gateway wrong-path test flake #55790
  • Consolidate local test execution #55787
    Area-AIEngineering
  • [wasm] Support browser-wasm/wasi-wasm ReadyToRun in ResolveReadyToRunCompilers #55785
    arch-wasm
  • Restore localized first-run messages in the NativeAOT CLI #55781
  • Split dotnetup environment variable documentation by audience #55780
  • Create a dedicated pipeline for weekly SDL checks #55779

Merged

  • Dispatch Issue Monster for CI incidents #55788
  • Reduce Issue Monster `base_branch` selection hallucinations w/ target vs source branch terms #55778
  • Reduce `issue_dispatch tool` hallucinations in the `issue monster` when making a tool call: #55777
  • [release/9.0.1xx] Cloak SignatureCycle2 from source build #55783
    Servicing-consider
  • [Experiment] Add CI Quality Investigator workflow #55467
  • Add WebAssembly project reference discovery targets #55782
    Area-WasmSdk, 11.0.1xx

Updated

  • Add F# hot reload support to dotnet-watch #55128
  • Bump MSTest.Sdk from 4.4.0-preview.26409.6 to 4.4.0-preview.26411.1 #55768
    dependencies, dependabot: main
  • Migrate templating search cache publishing to ESRP #55755
  • Avoid reporting CA1859 for properties with setter more accessible than getter #54122
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55497
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55754
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55735
  • Stop build-failure-analysis workflows from filing a public detection-runs issue #55771
